text:
ana: heads-up from the onboarding smoke run — parallel import spikes still causing duplicated pages + billing surprises. SDKs respect Retry-After but retries are synchronized so we hammer again. anyone seen this in sampleapps?
kevin: yup. reproduced with 6 parallel workers. pattern: client reads remaining, kicks off two batches, server 429s one, client retries both after Retry-After and they collide again.
olga: can you paste a minimal trace? curious whether the server is returning anything beyond Retry-After.
nana_trace: ```
POST /v1/embeds/batch 240ms
<- 429 Retry-After: 2
<- X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
<- body: {"code":"rate_limit","reason":"burst"}
```
ana: client sleeps 2s, then both workers retry nearly simultaneously.
marco: two things: (1) SDK default windowing is too aggressive for onboarding-style parallel imports; (2) independent worker processes share no session token so they don't coordinate inflight counts.
kevin: JS SDK jitter also had a seeding bug we saw before; low entropy in some environments makes jitter tiny so retries align. Go less affected.
olga: mitigation suggestions: - add a client-side slow-start algorithm (start with 1 inflight, double on success until max) - add maxInFlightPerSession config across SDKs - provide a lightweight leaky-bucket helper for sampleapps
marco: server could help too: return X-Queue-Pos (advisory) and optional X-Backoff-Factor so clients don't all use the same base backoff.
kevin: agree. also propose SDK telemetry: emit a warning metric when session sees >3 429s within 30s so we can alert onboarding churn.
olga: i'll own a tiny sampleapp change: wrap SDK calls with a local token-bucket that waits 50-300ms before retrying when empty. pseudo: 
```
if (!bucket.take()) { await sleep(rand(50,300)); continue }
await sdk.embed(batch)
```
marco: i'll add maxInFlightPerSession to go-sdk and js-sdk with default 4 for onboarding flows, and a test in the e2e harness that runs 10 parallel imports and asserts duplicates < 1.5x.
kevin: i'll fix the JS jitter seed bug and add a small runtime entropy check to log a warning if jitter variance looks off.
ci-bot: New issue created: INF-4400 "onboard slow-start + leaky-bucket mitigation" assigned to @marco @olga @kevin :white_check_mark:
nana: timeline? can we get quick wins in next sprint?
marco: yes. SDK flags + tests in sprint. sampleapp helper + PR next week. server headers as follow-up.
olga: i'll draft a short doc snippet showing recommended pacing algorithm and link the sampleapp demo.
nana: thanks — i'll coordinate QA and update the onboarding smoke tests to assert we don't exceed retry thresholds. :thumbsup:
